title: Hot Cross Buns 🍞 | Tiny Tune Town Nursery Rhymes & Kids Songs
intro: Hot cross buns! Nomi bakes with her family in a sunny kitchen: she mixes with Mummy, Nana rolls the dough, big brother Kofi makes a cross on every bun, Mummy bakes them warm, and everyone shares, even Mango the cat. A calm, cosy sing-along of the classic nursery rhyme for toddlers and preschoolers, with counting and baking steps.
actions: Stir the bowl: mix it, mix it, one, two, three
Roll a little ball of dough
Draw a cross with your finger
Count the pennies: one a penny, two a penny
Share a bun with someone you love
credit: Traditional public-domain nursery rhyme (Hot-Cross Buns, The Real Mother Goose, 1916; the street cry is in Christmas Box, 1798). New verses and music by Tiny Tune Town.
